{{Otheruses|Centax}}
'''Centaxday''' was a name for second [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Galactic Standard]] [[Standard week/Legends|week]] that was used on<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Jedi Trial">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> It shared its name with three of the planet's [[Moon/Legends|moons]]: [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]],<ref name="Jedi Trial" /> [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]],<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> and [[Centax-3/Legends|Centax-3]].<ref name="BtMF5">{{BuildFalconCite|5|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>

[[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] area, offered daily [[Soup/Legends|soups]] and specials on specific days of the week. [[Callosian spring vegetable soup]] was served on Centaxday for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. The lunch and dinner specials were a [[molecularly agitated cheese sandwich]] with a cup of soup for 5.5 credits and a [[L'lahsh-marinated nutrient globule]] with mixed [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] for 8.5 credits.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Centaxday was created<ref name="Story Behind the Story">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
